title: Timeline changes
description: A Timeline's changes (AD-20, FR-20, latex-kanban-timeline design decision 5): set operations of the one generic diff on an entry's lane, date, start or end, addressed as item.entry.field (AD-13's reference syntax without brackets): a lane's ID for lane, a full-date for the others, never null, so no day can be taken away. A Timeline never adds, removes or moves an entry, edits a label or changes a lane. Whether a moved range keeps its length is no check of the changes. In no schema set until latex-kanban-timeline registers it.
